title: AutomationEnvelope
description: Top-level envelope for a Tracto automation script. Validated before any step executes.

schemaVersion.description: Contract schema version in major.minor format (e.g. 1.0).

automationId.description: Lowercase path-like identifier. No path traversal (..). No executable extensions.

runtimeType.description: Target runtime environment for this automation. Must match the dispatching worker's runtimeType.

policyRefs.description: Optional list of policy document references that govern this automation's execution.

inputs.description: Typed input declarations. Values are supplied by the Orchestrator at dispatch time.

outputs.description: Typed output declarations. Each output must carry an approved evidence classification (see REF-08).

vars.description: C1: Script-scoped variable declarations. Validated before any step executes. Vars do not persist across run boundaries.

steps.description: Ordered list of step definitions. Executed sequentially unless control flow steps alter order.

InputDeclaration.description: Declaration of a typed input parameter for this automation.

type.description: Primitive type of this input. Structured types are not supported in v1.

nullable.description: Whether this input may be supplied as null. Defaults to false.

sensitive.description: Whether this input contains sensitive data. Sensitive inputs are redacted from telemetry.

OutputDeclaration.description: Declaration of a typed output produced by this automation. Each output requires an approved evidence classification.

type.description: Primitive type of this output. Structured types are not supported in v1.

evidenceClassification.description: Approved evidence/telemetry classification for this output (see REF-08, contract §ST1-01-AC07).

nullable.description: Whether this output may be null. Defaults to false.

VarDeclaration.description: C1: Script-scoped variable declaration. Written only via outputBinding; read via {ref:vars.<name>}. Duplicate names are a validation error.

type.description: Primitive type of this variable. Structured types may be introduced in a later contract major.

nullable.description: C1: Whether this variable may hold a null value. Defaults to false. Reading null when nullable=false is a VALIDATION error.

defaultValue.description: C1: Initial value for this variable. If absent, the var is uninitialized; reading it before any outputBinding populates it is a VALIDATION error (variable.uninitializedRead).

sensitivity.description: C1: Sensitivity classification. Sensitive vars must not be serialized into telemetry or Orchestrator state.

StepDefinition.description: An individual step in the automation. See step-envelope.schema.json for standalone use.

stepId.description: Unique step identifier within the automation. Lowercase, starts with a letter.

action.description: Fully qualified action name in namespace.action format (e.g. desktop.click, service.invoke).

inputs.description: Map of input parameter names to typed values or references.

outputBinding.description: C1: Map of declared var name to step output field reference. Writes are the only permitted way to assign a var.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum milliseconds this step may execute. See C3 for TIMED_OUT vs UNKNOWN step-state rules.

retryClass.description: Retry classification. TRANSIENT_SAFE permits bounded retry only when non-commitment is confirmed (C3).

precondition.description: Technical condition that must be true before the step executes.

postcondition.description: Technical condition verifying effect commitment after step completes. Failure may yield FAILED or UNKNOWN (C3).

onFailure.description: Handler invoked when this step reaches a terminal failure state.

sensitivity.description: Sensitivity classification for this step. Affects telemetry redaction.

TypedRef.description: A reference to a declared binding: input, var, step output, or secret.

ref.description: Reference path. Must point to a declared binding. Undeclared references are a VALIDATION error (variable.undeclaredReference).

TypedValue.description: A literal typed value (string, integer, boolean) or a reference to a declared binding.

TechnicalCondition.description: A technical predicate evaluated by the worker runtime. Must not encode business intent (see REF-01, contract §ST1-04-AC06).

predicate.description: Fully qualified predicate name (e.g. desktop.elementExists, api.statusCodeEquals).

args.description: Arguments passed to the predicate evaluator.

waitMs.description: Maximum milliseconds to poll for this condition. Zero means evaluate once.

pollIntervalMs.description: Polling interval in milliseconds when waitMs > 0.

OnFailureHandler.description: Specifies the failure handling strategy when a step reaches a terminal failure state.

handler.description: Named failure handler strategy (e.g. abort, continueWithDefault, escalate).

compensatingSteps.description: Ordered list of stepIds to execute as compensating actions before the handler runs.
